exely.title: Exely PMS webhook
exely.description:
In Exely: Hotel settings → API connection → your connection → Webhooks: Use webhooks = Yes.
URL: {url}
(Exely accepts only https://; the address must be reachable from the internet. Host: the Internet URL in Settings → System → Network.)
Authentication: API-KEY
Key: {api_key}
Events: check-in, check-out and their cancellations.

Rooms are matched automatically by name or number (Exely Room 01, 01 or 1 → Area Room 01) only when unambiguous. Other numbering (e.g. 101) must be mapped below.

data.exely_room_map: Room mapping (one per line: Exely room = HA Area)

data_description.exely_new_key: The current key stops working immediately; enter the new key in Exely.
data_description.exely_new_url: The current URL stops working immediately; enter the new URL in Exely.
